title: Item Auto-Balance (staff)
body:
Syntax: itemscale | itemscale preview <level> | itemscale <damage|armor|value|uses> <25-400|+/-delta> | itemscale reset <field|all>

Item AutoBalance is opt-in; old player gear, crafted items, and custom objects remain unchanged.

Builder: OSET <vnum> ITEMTYPE weapon|armor|tool; OSET <vnum> LEVEL <1-250>; OSET <vnum> FLAGS AutoBalance. Remove with OSET <vnum> FLAGS -AutoBalance. Use OSTAT <vnum> to preview effective fields.

Administrator: ITEMSCALE to see current percentages, ITEMSCALE PREVIEW <level>, ITEMSCALE DAMAGE <25-400>, ITEMSCALE ARMOR <25-400>, ITEMSCALE VALUE <25-400>, ITEMSCALE USES <25-400>, ITEMSCALE ARMOR +10 or ITEMSCALE DAMAGE -10 to shift a current percentage, ITEMSCALE RESET DAMAGE or ITEMSCALE RESET ALL.

Only flagged level 1-250 items are affected. Weapon base damage, armor AC protection, shop value, and tool maximum uses are calculated from item level and saved global settings. Explicit item DAMAGE, armor STATBONUS ARMOR_CLASS, COST and custom USES override their corresponding automatic values. The item name, VNUM, forged stats, gems and manual builder settings are never overwritten. Settings save to data/item_balance.json; runtime values update immediately (previously used tool durability is preserved).
